Ch135 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 135)

Subject: symplectic geometry | ID: 21765

Theorem

Let H be a Harnack space. Every simplex operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 1. The compact operator \(Q_{01350011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle Q_{01350011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. By the negative spectral theorem, we decompose \(A_{01350012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the negative spectral family.

Step 3. By compactness of the nilpotent spectral family \(W_{01350013}\), the image is precompact in the Banach space topology.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via asymptotic interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
